entry.title: String Operations
entry.summary:
What is a String ?
A string is a sequence of characters (letters, numbers, symbols, spaces, etc.) enclosed within quotes. In simple words: Text data = String How to create a string You can use: Single quotes ' '
Double quotes " "
Triple quotes ''' ''' or """ """ (for multi-line)
name = "Silambu" city = 'Chennai' msg = """This is multiple line string"""
String is immutable → you cannot change characters directly Each character has an index (position)
text = "Python"
print(text[0]) # P print(text[1]) # y
Common string operations name = "silambu"
print(name.upper()) # SILAMBU print(name.capitalize()) # Silambu print(name.lower()) # silambu print(len(name)) # 7 print("My name is " + name) #My name is Silambu
Both first & last letter capital name = "silambu"
result = name[0].upper() + name[1:-1] + name[-1].upper()
print(result)
Output: SilambU First letter → name[0].upper()
Last letter → name[-1].upper()
